placements.why: The content names an architectural concern — how the derive-id path handles headings without explicit id fields — requiring a new organizational category for system behavior guarantees that nothing existing covers.
placements.title: System behavior under adverse input
placements.theme: The system must degrade gracefully when inputs lack expected fields, producing valid output rather than crashing.

placements.title: Derive-id path must survive missing-id headings
placements.theme: When headings carry no explicit id field, the derive-id path must produce a valid slug rather than crash, guarding against the production failure pattern.
placements.why: src-1 reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from production (## heading, no id field); src-2 mandates the safe outcome — no crash, valid slug. Together they support the theme that derive-id must gracefully handle missing-id headings.
